en.title: Hitch user guide
en.description: Evaluate models and harnesses with Harbor-compatible tasks, parallel scheduling, and recovery.

zh-CN.title: Hitch 用户指南
zh-CN.description: 使用 Harbor 兼容任务评测模型与 Harness，并行调度实验并恢复中断的工作。

en.title: Quick Start
en.description: Install Hitch, authenticate Codex, inspect a local run, and submit two tasks in parallel.

zh-CN.title: Quick Start：快速开始
zh-CN.description: 安装 Hitch、完成 Codex 认证、查看本地运行结果，并提交两个并行任务。

en.title: Local and remote model inference
en.description: Use hosted APIs, managed local SGLang, and remote model nodes with explicit capacity and recovery.

zh-CN.title: 本地与远程模型推理
zh-CN.description: 接入云 API、托管本机 SGLang 和远程模型节点，理解推理容量与恢复。

en.title: Pin versions and isolate workspaces
en.description: Choose an exact harness reference and a workspace mode that fits your task.

zh-CN.title: 固定版本与隔离工作区
zh-CN.description: 选择确定的 Harness 引用，以及适合当前任务的工作区模式。

en.title: Read runs and evidence
en.description: Inspect results, bounded trajectories, verifier diagnostics, and message feedback.

zh-CN.title: 查看运行与证据
zh-CN.description: 查询结果、有界轨迹、Verifier 诊断和消息反馈。

en.title: Run your first evaluation
en.description: Choose a model or harness comparison, run a one-task Docker evaluation, and interpret the results.

zh-CN.title: 第一次评测
zh-CN.description: 选择模型或 Harness 对比，运行单任务 Docker 评测并理解结果。

en.title: Daemon: parallelism and recovery
en.description: Share resource capacity across evaluations and recover execution with durable plans, leases, and evidence.

zh-CN.title: Daemon：并行与恢复
zh-CN.description: 在评测间共享资源容量，依靠持久化计划、执行租约和证据恢复中断的工作。

en.title: Operate and troubleshoot
en.description: Queue work, manage concurrency, cancel tasks, and diagnose common failures.

zh-CN.title: 日常运行与排错
zh-CN.description: 排队执行任务、管理并发、取消运行并诊断常见失败。

en.title: CLI reference
en.description: Find every Hitch command, shared option, query filter, and advanced integration entry point.

zh-CN.title: CLI 命令参考
zh-CN.description: 查询全部 Hitch 命令、共享参数、筛选条件和高级集成入口。
